headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points while benchmark indices extended gains for a third straight week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment in the last trading session.
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) made a strong U-turn with Rs 84,000 crore inflows in November.
Lower crude oil prices and foreign fund inflows buoyed market momentum during the week.
PSU Banks led sectoral gains as benchmark indices extended their weekly rally.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex dropped 289 points and Nifty slipped due to inflation worries.
Indian stock markets recorded weekly gains for the 3rd straight week.
FPI inflows into Indian markets reached Rs 84,000 crore in November.
Mahanadi Coalfields filed its RHP for an upcoming IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November. On the last trading day, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns dragged sentiment. However, the markets closed the week higher, marking their third consecutive weekly gain supported by strong FPI inflows of Rs 84,000 crore in November.
